result: With an unbiased stochastic gradient of bounded variance, any algorithm needs Ω(ε^{−4}) queries in the worst case to find an ε-stationary point — so SGD is minimax optimal — and Ω(ε^{−3}) if the stochastic gradients are mean-squared smooth, matching SPIDER-type variance reduction.
result_plain: Stochastic lower bounds: ε^-4 (SGD optimal) and ε^-3 under mean-squared smoothness (variance reduction optimal).
